reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that agent-based reconnaissance must validate claims against ground truth, not just inspect code. The zero-importer sweep failed due to incomplete regex coverage, leading to false positives. Correcting this required spot-checking against verified truths. Similarly, the dark evaluator census failed because it conflated source-product names with actual table schemas—this led to misclassification of evaluators needing adapters versus those needing non-existent producers. The new finding of package-internal coherence reveals a deeper architectural layer: a set of modules that are internally consistent but unreachable from outside the package. These findings form a dual structure: one of validation errors (import parsing, schema alignment) and another of architectural invisibility (internal-only packages). Both reveal failure modes in static analysis when context-sensitive checks are omitted.
